About your checklist & lifer filters

Site quizzes include only species marked X in that site’s column. “Entire trip checklist” includes every species, including species without an X at any site. Lifer filters compare with your eBird export as of October 7, 2026. Colombia lifers include worldwide lifers. These are potential lifers based on your exported records, rather than the spreadsheet’s bold and italic formatting.

Scientific names were reconciled for 13 checklist spelling errors. The original spreadsheet is unchanged. Photos are sourced exclusively from the Macaulay Library and credited to their contributors. Internet access is needed to load them. With All families selected, question sets contain distinct species. When you select a specific family, species may repeat with different photos; each photo is used at most once per quiz. If you request more questions than the available species or photos, the quiz uses the entire available pool.

Regular and review answers are remembered by species in this browser, starting with this update. Recent review uses each species’ last 20 answered photos and includes it only when more than 25% were missed. Review quizzes ignore lifer filters and show each eligible species once, using any available photo. The end-of-quiz review includes every species missed in that quiz, even when its overall miss rate is 25% or less. Start over resets quiz settings, while keeping your learning history.
